<span class="hl-kw">package</span> com.platform.events.iam.principals;

<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>;
<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">List</span>;
<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">Map</span>;

<span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">record</span> PrincipalsSyncedData(
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> applicationCode,
    <span class="hl-type">int</span> created,
    <span class="hl-type">int</span> deactivated,
    <span class="hl-type">List</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>&gt; syncedEmails,
    <span class="hl-type">int</span> updated
) {

    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> PrincipalsSyncedData fromMap(<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; map) {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> PrincipalsSyncedData(
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;applicationCode&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;created&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;deactivated&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">List</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>&gt;) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;syncedEmails&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Integer</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;updated&quot;</span>)
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; toMap() {
        <span class="hl-kw">var</span> map = <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;();
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;applicationCode&quot;</span>, applicationCode);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;created&quot;</span>, created);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;deactivated&quot;</span>, deactivated);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;syncedEmails&quot;</span>, syncedEmails);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;updated&quot;</span>, updated);
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> map;
    }
}
